citation.title: Kim analysis combination factor and extraction index norms

curation.notes: accessed 2026-10-07 (both extractors read the live page that day). Page 'Updated March 27, 2026'. The page credits Kim IK (1978, 1987) and describes the sample as Korean Class I adults. Merge 2026-10-08 (Re-read with WebFetch on 2026-10-08, 15:19): #16 definitionMatch a 'same' / b 'close' -> close: the page defines its ODI with the AB plane to FH, not Kim 1974's AB plane to the mandibular plane, so its CF is not the app's sum. #17 a range 149.0–155.9 (the borderline band) / b mean 155.9 -> mean 155.9, no SD: the page gives no separate extraction-index norm, only thresholds on the CF; storing the borderline band as a norm range would show 'borderline' as 'normal'. The thresholds are in the note (they match the catalogue's bands). Values (CF 155.9 ± 6.24, SD column) matched both extractions.

caveats: Website values, not from a paper (status website; never coloured).
Only #16 combination factor and #17 extraction index are entered here, as briefed; the page's ODI (74.5 ± 6.07) and APDI (81.4 ± 3.82) rows are deliberately not entered (Kim's own papers cover them).

The page attributes its norms to 'Kim IK (1978, 1987)' and describes the sample as Korean Class I adults; this is the website's statement, unchecked, and looks garbled: Kim's ODI paper is Kim YH 1974 and APDI Kim & Vietas 1978.
The page's table has a column headed 'SD'; the CF's ± 6.24 is stored as sd. Its 'Clinical Range' 143.4°–168.4° is in the note.

The page's extraction-index bands (< 149.0° extraction; 149.0°–155.9° borderline; > 155.9° non-extraction) match the bands already in the catalogue for #17; the page gives no separate norm for the index, so #17 carries the CF mean only.
The CF on the page is the sum of the page's own ODI and APDI; the on-file source's ODI is not Kim 1974's (catalogue #15), so a CF from the app's ODI is not the same quantity as the page's.
